world_model_delta: Score milestones: SCOUT (50 pts), SETTLER (200 pts), HOLDER (500 pts), WARDEN (1000 pts). Milestones unlock cosmetic WULmoji ribbon variants — no mechanical effect, zero governance meaning. Milestone names intentionally parallel faction rank names to indicate progression; both are mechanical only.
validator_question: Do score milestones and faction ranks share enough vocabulary to cause namespace collision?
risk_of_symbol_smuggling: MEDIUM — parallel naming; both are mechanical; milestones = cosmetic only, ranks = mechanical capability
